categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes coin selection logic in `src/wallet/coinselection.cpp` and carries the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a latent bug where `SelectionResult::Clear()` does not reset `bump_fee_group_discount`, causing `GetTotalBumpFees()` to return negative values on cleared selections. As the description notes, production code currently avoids this by only clearing selections inside the knapsack solver before the discount is calculated, so there is no user-facing impact.
